newsitem.title: INDIA: India stock markets closed for national holiday.
newsitem.headline: India stock markets closed for national holiday.

text.p: Indian stock markets were closed on Friday for a Hindu festival holiday.
Shares are expected to consolidate when trading resumes on Monday after prices rose sharply this week following a pro-market 1997/98 (April-March) budget unveiled last Friday, traders said.

The Bombay Stock Exchange's top-30 index ended 64.95 points, or 1.65 percent, lower at 3,870.26 on Thursday. It hit 4,029.56 this week against 3,474.79 pre-budget close boosted by cuts in corporate and personal taxes.
